sql.processStepStatus.getTypes: select * from flow.process_step_status_type where archived is not true order by process_step_status_type
sql.processStepStatus.getTypesForCompany: select cpsst.*, psst.process_step_status_type as root_process_step_status_type from flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on psst.id = cpsst.process_step_status_type_id where cpsst.archived is not true and case when (:isParent and not :parentOverride) then company_id = :parentCompanyId else company_id = :companyId end order by cpsst.process_step_status_type
sql.processStepStatus.availableForProcessSte: select cpsst.*, psst.process_step_status_type as root_process_step_status_type from flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on psst.id = cpsst.process_step_status_type_id where cpsst.archived is not true and company_id = :companyId and not exists ( select id from flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst where pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id and pscpsst.archived is not true and pscpsst.process_step_id = :processStepId ) order by cpsst.process_step_status_type
sql.processStepStatus.getCancelledTypesForCo: select cpsst.*, psst.process_step_status_type as root_process_step_status_type from flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on psst.id = cpsst.process_step_status_type_id where cpsst.archived is not true and case when (:isParent and not :parentOverride) then company_id = :parentCompanyId else company_id = :companyId end and cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = 3 order by cpsst.process_step_status_type
sql.processStepStatus.getType: select cpsst.id, cpsst.process_step_status_type, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.archived, psst.process_step_status_type as root_process_step_status_type from flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on psst.id = cpsst.process_step_status_type_id where cpsst.id = :typeId
sql.processStepStatus.deleteType: update flow.company_process_step_status_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepStatus.updateType: update flow.company_process_step_status_type set process_step_status_type = :processStepStatusType, process_step_status_type_id = :processStepStatusTypeId, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepStatus.getProcessStepCompanyP: select pscpsst.*, ps.process_step_name, cpsst.process_step_status_type, cpsst.company_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id, psst.process_step_status_type as root_process_step_status_type from flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst inner join flow.process_step ps on pscpsst.process_step_id = ps.id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = psst.id where pscpsst.id = :id
sql.processStepStatus.deleteStatusFromProces: update flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepStatus.statusInUseByWQT: SELECT pswqtpsst.* FROM flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst inner join flow.process_step ps on pscpsst.process_step_id = ps.id inner join flow.process_step_work_queue_type pswqt on ps.id = pswqt.process_step_id inner join flow.process_step_work_queue_type_process_step_status_type pswqtpsst on pswqt.id = pswqtpsst.process_step_work_queue_type_id and pswqtpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id WHERE pscpsst.id = :id and pscpsst.archived is not true and pswqtpsst.archived is not true and pswqt.archived is not true
sql.processStepStatus.getActiveAssignedToPro: SELECT cpsst.id, pscpsst.process_step_id as "processStepId", pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.archived, ps2.process_step_name as "processStepName", cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", cpsst.process_step_status_type_id as "processStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.company_id as "companyId", psst.process_step_status_type as "rootProcessStepStatusType" FROM flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst inner join flow.process_step ps2 on pscpsst.process_step_id = ps2.id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = psst.id WHERE pscpsst.process_step_id = :processStepId AND pscpsst.archived is not true and cpsst.archived is not true and cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = 1 order by cpsst.process_step_status_type
sql.processStepStatus.getAssignedToStep: SELECT cpsst.id, pscpsst.process_step_id as "processStepId", pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.archived, ps2.process_step_name as "processStepName", cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", cpsst.process_step_status_type_id as "processStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.company_id as "companyId", psst.process_step_status_type as "rootProcessStepStatusType" FROM flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst inner join flow.process_step ps2 on pscpsst.process_step_id = ps2.id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = psst.id WHERE pscpsst.process_step_id = :processStepId AND pscpsst.archived is not true and cpsst.archived is not true order by cpsst.process_step_status_type
sql.processStepStatus.getCancelledAssignedTo: SELECT cpsst.id, pscpsst.process_step_id as "processStepId", pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.archived, ps2.process_step_name as "processStepName", cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", cpsst.process_step_status_type_id as "processStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.company_id as "companyId", psst.process_step_status_type as "rootProcessStepStatusType" FROM flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst inner join flow.process_step ps2 on pscpsst.process_step_id = ps2.id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = psst.id WHERE pscpsst.process_step_id = :processStepId AND pscpsst.archived is not true and cpsst.archived is not true AND cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = 3 order by cpsst.process_step_status_type
